tracks.purpose: D20 class features, proficiency, spell progression and core character rules
MMORPG horizontal progression: mastery, specialization choices, crafting, collection, exploration and cosmetics

designRules: Do not extend class proficiency or spell progression beyond the selected D20 ruleset.
Do not grant unlimited attack bonuses or ability-score inflation from Paragon ranks.
Use item tiers, encounter scaling, mastery choices and horizontal progression to support long-term play.
Keep PvP normalized by bracket and item power budget.
All XP thresholds are game-specific after level 20 and must be tuned with telemetry.
